description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for handling git remote groups, including setup, updating remotes, and testing behavior with group configurations.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Sets a marker file with a given string to facilitate test assertions.

methods.name: update_repo
methods.description: Updates a git repository by appending content to a file, adding it, and committing with a message from 'mark'.

methods.name: update_repos
methods.description: Calls 'update_repo' for two repositories named 'one' and 'two'.

methods.name: repo_fetched
methods.description: Checks if a remote repository has been fetched by comparing the latest commit message to the marker.
